desc: Enumerate the four diagonal directions and define the fixed clockwise 90-degree turn mapping (DR→DL→UL→UR→DR, i.e. d→(d+1)%4).
Precompute straight alternating suffix lengths R[d][cell] (starting at each cell in each direction) in the correct reverse iteration order.
Precompute straight alternating prefix lengths f[d][cell] (ending at each cell in direction d, starting at value 1) in the correct forward iteration order.
Combine first arm f[d] with second arm R[(d+1)%4] at each turn vertex, subtracting 1 for the shared vertex; R>=1 also covers zero-turn straight segments.
Initialize answer to 1 if any cell holds value 1 (handles length-1 and no-turn cases), 0 otherwise.
Validate against all four provided examples (5, 4, 5, 1) and edge cases (1x1 grid, no valid segment).
Confirm O(n*m) time and memory with small constant, suitable for n,m <= 500.
